title: Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking
abstract: arXiv:2610.02010v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Invisible watermarking has become a central tool for tracing AI-generated images, but its robustness against adaptive removal attacks remains an open security question. We introduce Latent Frequency Masking, an attack that erases watermark evidence by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the latent representation of a watermarked image. The replacement can be sampled from Gaussian noise for efficiency or derived from diffusion regeneration for improved image preservation. We provide a theoretical distortion bound relating the change between the reconstructed adversarial image and the masked latent-frequency perturbation. We evaluate the proposed attack against six diffusion watermarking methods on images generated from DiffusionDB and MS-COCO prompts. Latent Frequency Masking removes or substantially weakens several watermarks while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime compared with existing attacks. Thes

translated_title: 探索生成式图像水印针对潜在频率掩码攻击的弱点
translated_abstract: 隐形水印已成为追踪AI生成图像的核心工具，但其对自适应去除攻击的鲁棒性仍然是一个悬而未决的安全问题。我们提出了潜在频率掩码攻击，这是一种通过替换水印图像潜在表示中选定傅里叶系数来擦除水印证据的攻击方法。替换系数可以从高斯噪声中采样以提高效率，或从扩散再生中获取以改善图像保真度。我们提供了理论失真边界，将重建的对抗图像与掩码潜在频率扰动之间的变化联系起来。我们在由DiffusionDB和MS-COCO提示词生成的图像上，针对六种扩散水印方法评估了所提出的攻击。潜在频率掩码在保持感知质量的同时，相比现有攻击实现了更有利的运行时间，并成功移除或大幅削弱了多种水印。
tldr: 提出潜在频率掩码攻击方法，通过替换水印图像潜在表示中的傅里叶系数，在保持图像感知质量和较低运行时间的同时，有效移除或削弱六种扩散式图像水印。
en_tdlr: Proposes Latent Frequency Masking, an attack that removes or substantially weakens six diffusion-based image watermarks by replacing Fourier coefficients in the latent representation while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime.
